name: Oscilloscope, 4 channels (Rigol DS1054Z)
description: Rigol's DS1054Z digital storage oscilloscope: four channels at 50 MHz, 1 GSa/s with one channel on (500 MSa/s with two, 250 MSa/s with three or four), 8 bits, 1 mV/div to 10 V/div, its inputs 1 MOhm || 15 pF (10 MOhm through the 10x probes it ships with). It acquires around an edge trigger in Auto, Normal or Single, and the workbench draws its screen and controls live as the circuit runs.

pins.name: CH1
pins.doc: Channel 1's probe tip: 1 MOhm || 15 pF at 1x, 10 MOhm || 15 pF through the 10x probe

pins.name: GND

ch1_scale.doc: Channel 1's vertical scale, volts a division (1 mV to 10 V at 1x, times the probe)

ch1_probe.doc: Channel 1's probe: its loading (1 MOhm or 10 MOhm) and the scale's range

timebase.doc: Seconds a division across (5 ns to 50 s), 12 divisions on the screen

delay.doc: The trigger's position from the screen's centre (positive: later)

trig_source.doc: The channel the edge trigger watches

sweep.doc: Auto (forced when no trigger comes), Normal (only on a trigger) or Single (one acquisition, then stopped)

holdoff.doc: The least time from one trigger to the next (16 ns to 10 s)

memory.doc: Memory depth: 12 Mpts on one channel (6 on two, 3 on three or four), or twice that with the option

inputs.name: run
inputs.doc: Run (true) or Stop (false); in Single, true arms one acquisition

outputs.name: status
outputs.doc: WAIT, T'D, AUTO or STOP, as the screen shows it

outputs.name: sample_rate
outputs.doc: The sample rate for the channels on and the timebase

outputs.name: ch1_v
outputs.doc: The voltage at channel 1's tip now

omissions: the other trigger types (pulse, runt, window, nth edge, slope, video, pattern, delay, timeout, duration, setup/hold) and the RS232, I2C and SPI options
math, FFT, XY and Roll
averaging, peak detect and high resolution acquisition
the probe's compensation and its own bandwidth
the DC gain and offset errors and noise: the readings are exact to their 8 bits
Auto's wait before forcing a trigger (assumed: the screen's time, at least 10 ms)
the hardware frequency counter (Measure, Counter): the measurements are the automatic ones, made as the scope makes them on the screen's 1200 points a channel

electrical.claims: Its inputs load the circuit (1 MOhm or, through the 10x probe, 10 MOhm, each || 15 pF); acquisitions at the sample rate the channels on and the memory allow, through a first-order 50 MHz (or 20 MHz) bandwidth, DC, AC or GND coupled, quantised at 8 bits over 10 divisions; the edge trigger with its level, slope and holdoff in Auto, Normal or Single.

sources.title: RIGOL MSO1000Z/DS1000Z User's Guide, chapter 18 (Specifications): 1 GSa/s (single channel), 500 MSa/s (dual), 250 MSa/s (3/4 channels); memory 12M/6M/3M points (24M/12M/6M optional); 8-bit vertical; 1 mV/div to 10 V/div (1X); offset +-2 V (1 mV-499 mV/div), +-100 V (500 mV-10 V/div); (1 MOhm +-1 %) || (15 pF +-3 pF); DC, AC, GND coupling; DS1054Z DC to 50 MHz, 20 MHz bandwidth limit, calculated rise time 7 ns; timebase 5 ns/div to 50 s/div; trigger Auto, Normal, Single, level +-5 div, holdoff 16 ns to 10 s; edge rising, falling, rising/falling
sources.notes: Read from the specifications chapter's PDF (TestEquity's copy, assets.testequity.com).

fr.description: L'oscilloscope numérique à mémoire DS1054Z de Rigol : quatre voies à 50 MHz, 1 Géch/s avec une voie active (500 Méch/s avec deux, 250 Méch/s avec trois ou quatre), 8 bits, 1 mV/div à 10 V/div, ses entrées 1 MOhm || 15 pF (10 MOhms à travers les sondes 10x fournies). Il acquiert autour d'un déclenchement sur front en Auto, Normal ou Single, et l'atelier dessine son écran et ses commandes en direct pendant que le circuit tourne.

omissions: les autres types de déclenchement (impulsion, runt, fenêtre, n-ième front, pente, vidéo, motif, retard, délai d'attente, durée, établissement/maintien) et les options RS232, I2C et SPI
les fonctions math, FFT, XY et Roll
les acquisitions en moyenne, détection de crête et haute résolution
la compensation de la sonde et sa propre bande passante
les erreurs de gain et de décalage en continu et le bruit : les lectures sont exactes sur leurs 8 bits
l'attente du mode Auto avant de forcer un déclenchement (supposée : la durée de l'écran, au moins 10 ms)
le fréquencemètre matériel (Measure, Counter) : les mesures sont les mesures automatiques, faites comme l'oscilloscope les fait sur les 1200 points par voie de l'écran

electrical.claims: Ses entrées chargent le circuit (1 MOhm ou, à travers la sonde 10x, 10 MOhms, chacune || 15 pF) ; acquisitions à la fréquence d'échantillonnage que permettent les voies actives et la mémoire, à travers une bande passante du premier ordre de 50 MHz (ou 20 MHz), en couplage DC, AC ou GND, quantifiées sur 8 bits sur 10 divisions ; le déclenchement sur front avec son niveau, sa pente et son holdoff en Auto, Normal ou Single.
